community: Lilligant is admired among fans for its elegant, flower-crowned design, and its relaxing fragrance detail from the Pokédex often comes up in discussions of the calmest-looking Pokémon in Unova.

why.text: The fragrance from Lilligant's garland has a relaxing effect on everyone nearby, its own Pokédex entry says.
Even veteran trainers find it a real challenge to get Lilligant's flower to bloom, per the Pokédex.
As the Flowering Pokémon, Lilligant has become popular with celebrities for its beautiful bloom.
